top_signals.title: Trump doesn’t plan to raise Nvidia, spy issue during China trip: U.S. officials
top_signals.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned this week after reports of multiple affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy, Alice Huang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
